# PlatformIO Core version constraints for CI.
#
# platform-espressif32's builder/penv_setup.py installs Python deps into .pio/penv
# with an unpinned "pioarduino>=6.1.19" spec. Core 6.2.0 (published 2026-09-15)
# swaps tool-scons to scons-local-4.11.1 via update_core_packages() mid-build,
# which breaks the 55.03.311 linker step (SCons.Tool.FortranCommon import error).
# Pin until pioarduino pins the penv spec or ships a compatible platform release.
pioarduino==6.1.19
